title: manihot loeflingii var. multifida
intro: Manihot loeflingii var. multifida, commonly known as Poi or Loulu, is a type of plant that belongs to the Euphorbiaceae family. It is a medicinal plant that has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including treating fever, sore throats, and respiratory issues due to its antimicrobial and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Manihot loeflingii var. multifida include its ability to modulate the immune system, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antioxidant activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
